name: confirmedCredentialCompromiseCount
definition: The number of credentials NodeZero confirmed as compromised in its most recent op; 0 only from an op that reports an integer confirmed_credentials_count of 0.
population: The single most recent op in the ops page (latest launched_at) for one NodeZero tenant; the value is that op's confirmed_credentials_count. Earlier ops are summed only into totalConfirmedCredentialsAcrossOps and never into the key.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: For 0: the most recent op reports an integer confirmed_credentials_count equal to 0. A missing op, or an op without that field, is not 0.

changeLog.change: Registered so the Horizon3 NodeZero transforms can emit it; the meaning is what the transform reads, stated precisely. Unverified fields are named in notes.

notes: Only the NodeZero transform emits this key today. Field names are as that transform reads them; they were not live-verified against a NodeZero tenant, so the key stays proposed at V0 with the owner not yet named.
